sections.title: Actions
sections.summary: Registered actions are the primary execution gateway. Define what work an agent is allowed to ask Igris to run, then run those actions through Igris with policy, tenant-scoped idempotency, runtime routing, recovery, and proof.

endpoints.auth: Session cookie or igris_ API key
endpoints.description: Lists the registered actions owned by the authenticated tenant.

endpoints.auth: Session cookie or igris_ API key
endpoints.description: Creates a registered action definition: the contract for what an agent may ask Igris to run.

endpoints.auth: Session cookie or igris_ API key
endpoints.description: Gets one registered action definition by id.

endpoints.auth: Session cookie or igris_ API key
endpoints.description: Updates a registered action definition.

endpoints.auth: Session cookie or igris_ API key
endpoints.description: Archives a registered action so it can no longer be run.

endpoints.auth: Session cookie or igris_ API key
endpoints.description: Runs a registered action by id or name. Raw, unregistered action definitions are not accepted.

endpoints.auth: Session cookie or igris_ API key
endpoints.description: Runs a registered action by name. This is the endpoint agents call in production.

endpoints.auth: Session cookie or igris_ API key
endpoints.description: Inspects one action run: status, proof state, and a redacted input summary.
